intro.h2: Stone counters without the long wait
paragraphs: The Stone Mill supplies and installs kitchen countertops in Ocean Springs, cut from granite, other natural stone and quartz. Homeowners come here for kitchen counters, bathroom vanity tops and wet bars, and the reviews keep coming back to two things: fair prices and how quickly the work gets done.

One customer was told 4 weeks by other companies. The Stone Mill finished her full kitchen counters and both bathrooms in 2 weeks. Another family used the shop for a new kitchen and a wet bar and named Ashley and Nick for their help and advice. They called the team affordable and dependable.

items.name: Granite kitchen countertops
items.blurb: Granite counters for kitchens and islands, from busy speckled stone to dramatic slabs with brown and gold movement. Reviewers say the prices were right and the work moved fast: one customer's full kitchen and two bathrooms were done in two weeks.

image.alt: Open kitchen with gray and white speckled granite perimeter counters and a matching granite island

items.name: Quartz countertops and islands
items.blurb: Quartz in clean white with soft gray veining, used on large islands with farmhouse sinks and on full kitchen runs. The Stone Mill's own Facebook page describes its work as competitive pricing on exceptional quality natural stone and quartz counters.

image.alt: White kitchen island with gray-veined quartz top, stainless farmhouse sink and dark faucet

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: Granite and quartz vanity tops with undermount sinks for hall baths and primary baths. One reviewer had both of her bathrooms done along with her full set of kitchen counters, and all of it was finished in the same two-week window.

image.alt: Bathroom vanity with speckled black, white and gray granite top, undermount sink and black-framed mirror

items.name: Wet bars and bar tops
items.blurb: Bar and beverage areas with stone tops, bar sinks and room for a wine cooler. A customer who built a new kitchen and wet bar with The Stone Mill said the team was affordable, dependable and cost effective.

image.alt: Wet bar with white quartz countertop, square stainless bar sink, brushed faucet and white cabinets above a wine cooler

why_choose_us.h2: Why Gulf Coast homeowners pick The Stone Mill

items.title: Fast turnaround
items.text: "Other companies had told us 4 weeks, they had everything completed in 2 weeks," one Google reviewer wrote about her kitchen counters and two bathrooms.

items.title: Prices that fit the budget
items.text: Price comes up in review after review. Customers call the shop affordable and cost effective, and one wrote that the team was willing to work within her budget and fast.

items.title: People who know stone
items.text: Customers mention staff by name: Ashley was "amazing to work with" and Nick was "so knowledgeable and helpful with advice and recommendations" on a kitchen and wet bar.

items.title: Granite and quartz in one place
items.text: The shop works with both natural stone and quartz, from speckled granite and bold, swirling slabs to white quartz with soft gray veining, so you can find the look that fits your room.

about.text: The Stone Mill is a granite and quartz countertop supplier at 7312 Rose Farm Rd in Ocean Springs, Mississippi. On Facebook, where 820 people follow the shop, it describes itself as offering competitive pricing on exceptional quality natural stone and quartz counters. Its counters go into new kitchens, bathroom remodels and wet bars. Customers mention Ashley and Nick by name for their help and advice, and one reviewer said she could not be happier with the quality or the install of her kitchen counters.

image.alt: Close-up of a granite countertop with swirling brown, cream and gold patterns

steps.title: Call or visit
steps.text: Call (601) 909-5772 on a weekday between 8:30 AM and 5 PM, or send a Facebook message, to talk through your project.

steps.title: Pick your stone
steps.text: Choose between granite, other natural stone and quartz. Staff can give advice and recommendations on what suits your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Measure and cut
steps.text: Your counters are measured and cut to fit, including the holes for sinks and faucets so your plumber can finish the hookup.

steps.title: Install and walk through
steps.text: The tops are set in your home. Look everything over with the installer and point out anything you want checked before they leave.

service_area.text: The Stone Mill is based at 7312 Rose Farm Rd in Ocean Springs, Mississippi, and Ocean Springs is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you are planning new counters for a kitchen, bathroom or wet bar in or near Ocean Springs, call (601) 909-5772 or email the shop to ask whether your home is within their install area.

items.q: Do you sell granite and quartz?
items.a: Yes. The Stone Mill is listed on Google as a granite supplier, and its Facebook page says it offers natural stone and quartz counters. The photos show speckled granite, bold exotic granite and white quartz with gray veining, so you can compare both before you choose.

items.q: How long does a countertop job take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job and the stone you pick, so ask when you call. One Google reviewer said other companies quoted her 4 weeks, and The Stone Mill completed her full kitchen counters and both bathrooms in 2 weeks.

items.q: Do you do bathroom vanity tops and wet bars?
items.a: Yes. Customers on Google describe The Stone Mill doing both bathrooms along with a full kitchen, and a new kitchen with a wet bar. The gallery includes a granite vanity top and a quartz wet bar top with a bar sink.

The Stone Mill is open Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Outside those hours you can email info@stonemillco.com or message the shop on Facebook with your project details and a few photos of the space.

The shop is at 7312 Rose Farm Rd, Ocean Springs, MS 39564. Ocean Springs is the town listed on its Google and Facebook pages. If you live outside Ocean Springs, call (601) 909-5772 and ask whether your address is in their install area.
